invented.quote: With the bridge closed, we have cash into autumn 2027 before counting any new revenue.
invented.why: The brief gives no calendar year (such as 2027), and the total cash of $940,000 at $95,000 reducing to $75,000 per month only lasts about a year from closing in December, reaching late the following year rather than a second autumn.
